corrections.note: Put the traffic and conversion numbers in the first paragraph, before any commentary.
corrections.was: Overall it was a positive week for the account, with several highlights worth noting.
corrections.should: Sessions 18,420 (+12%), conversions 214 (+9%). The rise came from paid search.

corrections.note: Never use exclamation marks, and never write "unfortunately". State what happened instead.
corrections.should: The email campaign opened at 18% against a target of 24%.

corrections.note: End every report with exactly one ask for the client, with a date. Not two, not a general "let us know".
corrections.was: Let us know if you have any thoughts on the plan.
corrections.should: Could you confirm the revised budget by Wednesday 16 September?

corrections.note: Name the channel (paid search, paid social, email) next to every number. Clients get confused by blended totals.
corrections.should: Paid search conversions were up 9% (214 vs 196), paid social was flat.
